description: Expose bounded low-cardinality runtime signals, tri-state OTel health, ranked route amplification, and truthful per-request agent-path work counts without making observability business state or feeding the built-in collector back into itself.

tasks.title: Build the runtime observability publication core
tasks.description: Create RuntimeObservability, the complete Meter catalog, process-local snapshot/degradation state, and typed ingestion publication contract. Switch current ingestion to real received/saved/dropped/write-failed outcomes and prove reserved rejection through a fake protection publisher, without adding status HTTP/CLI, sampling, request accounting or rejection policy.
acceptanceCriteria: RuntimeObservability is one thread-safe process-local authority for Meter, counters, degradation sources, latest reason and immutable snapshot; it has no business persistence or decision dependency.
Exact Mohist.Server.Runtime names/kinds/units/attributes/bounded values are created in one catalog and locked by MeterListener tests; identity labels are forbidden.
Current ingestion publishes one IngestOutcome per parsed attempt with duplicate/pre-parse/malformed/retryable-rollback semantics from D1.
A fake protection publisher drives non-zero rejected through production RecordIngest; #437/#471 remain owners of real rejection policy/producer.

Degradation sources cannot clear each other; protection expiry uses fake time; latest message truncates at 256 characters and survives recovery; structured transition fields/log cardinality are locked.
No metrics exporter targets the built-in receiver and no test needs external backend, real time, filesystem, network or process. Focused tests and npm test pass.
tasks.output: RuntimeObservability, IngestOutcome and Meter catalog; ingestion integration; deterministic degradation/fake rejection/metric-contract tests.
tasks.notes: Large preparatory abstraction allowed by the task-splitting rules: directly consumable by MeterListener and immutable snapshot, and stable for #437/#471 plus all later slices. No status, sampler, request scope or route ring.

tasks.title: Deliver the tri-state OTel status baseline
tasks.description: Expose T-001 through fixed /otel/api/status and mo otel status, wire normal startup/off behavior, and deliver the production one-shot storage readiness probe with timeout-before-initialization and fakeable metadata-length seams. Process/growth fields remain unavailable and routes empty until later tasks.
acceptanceCriteria: Status is always reachable with Server and reports off/healthy/degraded; enabled starts unverified, normal collector success and one readiness probe establish healthy.

T-002 adds OtelDb.OpenReadinessConnection: before constructing/opening the connection it clones the read-write string with Default Timeout=1, then runs existing fixed initialization; it is the production target of IOtelReadinessConnectionFactory and the probe reads PRAGMA schema_version once.
T-002 adds nullable IFileSystem.GetFileLength to every production/test implementation; the probe calls database/WAL/SHM once each, treats null as absent/zero, and propagates other metadata failures.

A named shared-memory SQLite test verifies the production OtelDb method returns DefaultTimeout=1 with initialized schema, without wall-clock lock timing; throwing connection-factory fakes verify corrupt/locked/open mapping; FakeFileSystem verifies missing/error/order/count with no host storage.
Fixed payload/unavailable fields are correct; old count status is removed and status snapshot does no dependencies, COUNT(*) or history work.
Before T-003 installs resource sampling, off runs no listener/exporter/sampler/maintenance/Meter measurements/aggregation; /api/health remains successful and OTel self-feedback tests terminate.
CLI validates/render states/unavailable values and old/server-down payload behavior. Focused server/CLI tests and npm test pass.
tasks.output: OtelDb readiness-open operation, IOtelReadinessConnectionFactory, IFileSystem metadata-length extension and production IOtelStorageProbe; fixed status DTO/API/CLI, normal startup/off wiring, and health/feedback/no-scan/probe tests.
tasks.notes: Owns the production probe and a one-shot OtelStatusInitializer. T-003 must remove that initializer registration when it installs the continuous sampler. Rejection display consumes T-001 only.

tasks.title: Add continuous process and storage pressure sampling
tasks.description: Replace T-002's one-shot initializer with one serialized sampler that reads process resources in every state, reuses the production storage probe only while enabled, and then follows injected 10-second ticks. Add CPU, working set, GC heap and storage growth gauges/status without claiming host-filesystem cancellation.
acceptanceCriteria: OtelStatusInitializer registration and implementation are removed/replaced, not retained; exactly one immediate startup probe exists after this task.

One serial loop coalesces ticks, never overlaps storage probes, starts no new work on shutdown and awaits the current fixed-operation call; no filesystem elapsed/cancellation guarantee or abandoned Task.Run worker exists.
Immediate working-set/GC-heap availability, CPU normalization with first-sample warm-up null, 60-second seven-slot growth ring and 1-GiB design budget match D5.

Success followed by failure invalidates cached storage values, omits those gauges and returns null while storage_read activates; off still refreshes status-only process values but performs no storage call and emits no Meter measurement.
Controllable operation signals, fake process data and existing probe seams test behavior without real time/storage. Focused tests and npm test pass.
tasks.output: OtelDiagnosticsSampler replacing the one-shot initializer, always-on bounded process reader, enabled-only storage scheduling, gated resource gauges/status fields and deterministic tests.
tasks.notes: Operation count is bounded; shutdown elapsed time is not promised if a host metadata syscall blocks.

tasks.title: Install request-local work accounting
tasks.description: Deliver RequestWorkScope snapshots/atomic close/detach suppression and the HTTP, EF, Orleans and HttpClient accounting boundaries as one independently tested request-metrics module. Keep scopes active for canonical and compatibility agent reads while OTel is off, but suppress Meter publication then and clear scope across incoming Orleans turns.
acceptanceCriteria: Middleware creates/clears scope when OTel enabled or an agent canonical/compatibility route runs; CompleteRequest and Meter publication occur only while enabled.

Snapshot() is immutable/readable before middleware completion without closing scope; CloseAndSnapshot atomically closes at response completion, with increments before close included and increments after close ignored.
Business EF commands, caller-side Orleans sends and innermost physical HTTP sends/retries count once; all production/custom test DbContextFactory roots install one interceptor.
Incoming Orleans filter saves/clears/restores scope; real in-process chain proves no grain-to-grain or grain-DB leakage.

RequestWorkScope.SuppressFlow clears only its ambient slot while detached work is queued; separate deterministic tests prove post-close increments no-op, a suppressed child observes no current scope, and each migrated SystemUpdateService/BackgroundHermesIssueNotificationDispatcher launcher starts its callback without that scope.
OTel endpoints/maintenance create no scope and direct otel.db is excluded. Off agent scopes count locally but emit/retain nothing.
Route/method/status label normalization and forbidden identities match D2. Adapter, snapshot, parallel, retry, off and feedback tests plus npm test pass.
tasks.output: RequestWorkScope Snapshot/CloseAndSnapshot/SuppressFlow, migrated detached launchers, middleware, EF interceptor, Orleans incoming/outgoing filters, HttpClient handler, composition-root updates and integration/unit tests.
tasks.notes: Standalone request Meter capability and exact snapshot dependency for T-007. No route ring/status rows or agent DTOs here.

tasks.title: Expose the bounded ranked route summary
tasks.description: Add the bounded five-minute route ring over T-004 request observations and expose identical ranked rows through status API and CLI. Keep selection threshold-free and deterministic.
acceptanceCriteria: Ring is 301 one-second buckets, 256 routes plus other per bucket, under-one-second boundary tolerance, no persistence, max 10 rows and registered routes under cap.

Amplification is DB calls/request + downstream calls/request with equal weight; order is amplification desc, average latency desc, route ordinal asc including other; ties/zero denominators are locked.
Status/CLI render identical rows without new status-read dependency; off retains no buckets and restart starts empty.
Overflow, expiry, restart, ranking, route cap and no-external-reader tests use fake time/operation counts. Focused tests and npm test pass.
tasks.output: Bounded route ring/ranking, RuntimeObservability route snapshots, status/CLI rows and focused tests.
tasks.notes: Anomalous means threshold-free top-ranked diagnostic, not alerting.

tasks.title: Preserve degraded status through OTLP bind fallback
tasks.description: Require a partially started host to stop and dispose before alternate construction while preserving enabled intent and degraded status. Abort fallback if either shutdown step fails.
acceptanceCriteria: After classified bind failure StopAsync is awaited and DisposeAsync attempted in finally; alternate starts only if both succeed, otherwise failure is logged/propagated.
Alternate omits only OTLP listener, preserves Enabled and reports collector_bind_failed; successful fallback leaves one host/silo/sampler and healthy core API.
Injected lifecycle tests cover success, stop failure/no rebuild and dispose failure/no rebuild without real sockets/processes.
Normal startup remains correct. Focused tests and npm test pass.
tasks.output: Exception-safe Program.cs fallback lifecycle, deterministic lifecycle seam and one-host/silo/sampler tests.
tasks.notes: Any StopAsync or DisposeAsync failure is terminal for fallback.

tasks.title: Expose agent status and activity amplification
tasks.description: Add amplification to canonical project-scoped agent responses and restore literal /api/agent/status|activity as project-selector compatibility aliases delegating to the same handlers. Use T-004's final snapshot so values stay truthful while OTel is off and publish path metrics only while enabled.
acceptanceCriteria: Canonical routes and compatibility aliases return identical scoped behavior; aliases resolve projectId query then X-Mohist-Project, return 400 when absent, and never aggregate globally.
All responses contain actual non-negative candidates, processed, transcriptRecords, databaseCalls and downstreamCalls for empty/off/enabled cases; off emits/retains nothing.
Status and activity candidate/processed/transcript materialization semantics match D8; final Snapshot() occurs after all awaited work before serialization.
Enabled path labels are only agent.status/activity; no identity labels, persistence or business decision changes.

Tests replace legacy 404 expectations with alias project-resolution/parity/400 cases and cover filtering, reconciliation, transcript reads, 200 limit, history-heavy and off/enabled behavior without #467/#468. Focused tests and npm test pass.
tasks.output: Canonical agent amplification DTOs/observations, unscoped project-selector aliases, off-state response accounting, path metrics and AgentOps/Session/API tests.
tasks.notes: Expose current amplification only; #467/#468 reduce it later. Count transcript per materialization.
